analysis_frame: The basmala is included and supports the divine-source, revelation, purity, and mercy frame without adding branch IDs absent from the QAC inventory.
The first ayah holds rejection, scripture-community identity, polytheism, non-cessation, arrival, and clear proof in one suspended construction.
The second and third ayahs identify the proof through a messenger from Allah reciting purified sheets that contain upright writings.
The fourth ayah reverses expectation: division occurs after the clear proof has arrived to those given the scripture.
